fit_reason: Although tagged as a private seller, the listing text and photos show this is dealer stock from Unique Classic Cars, photographed in their showroom with dealer banners and plates.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and quarter panels is glossy with sharp reflections
Chrome bumpers front and rear are bright and clean
Wheels and tires look clean and dressed
Underside shown is clean and freshly finished
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1969 Camaro Yenko tribute. The blue paint and chrome already look sharp in the photos. If you ever want an interior or exterior detail that comes to you, we'd be happy to give you a quote.
